spans.s: 1 या॑त् (abl. adv.) in as much as, as long as, since.
2 †यात् v. ऋणया॑त्.
यत॑ a. held, restrained, checked, controlled.
यतचित्तात्मन् a. restraining one's mind and self.
यतचेतस् a. restrained in mind.
यतनीय n. impers. = यतितव्य.
यतम॑ a. who or which (rel.) of many.
यतम॑था adv. in which (rel.) of many ways.
यतर॑ a. who or which (rel.) of two.
यतर॑था adv. in which (rel.) of two ways.

यतव्रत a. observing vows;
 devout, firm, constant.

यत॑स्रुच् a. lifting up or stretching out the sacrificial
ladle.
यतात्मन् a. self-restrained.
यता˚त्मवन्त् a. self-restrained.
1 य॑ति pl. as many (correl. of त॑ति).

3 य॑ति f. restraint, control;
 pause, caesura.
यतिचान्द्रायण n. a kind of penance.
यतितव्य n. impers. to be striven after (loc.).
यतित्व n. the state of an ascetic.
यतिथ॑ f. ई॑ the as (rel.) maniest.
यतिधा॑ adv. in as (rel.) many parts or ways.
यतिन् m. ascetic.
यतिपात्र n. an ascetic's vessel.
यतिवेष a. wearing an ascetic's garments.
य॑त्काम a. which desiring.
यत्काम्या॑ (instr. adv.) in which design.

यत्कारणम्^1 adv. for which motive or reason;
 because,
since.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.
यत्कृते adv. wherefore, why.

यत्न m. endeavour, effort, labour, pains about (loc. or
—˚). ˚—, instr., abl. & adv. in तस् with effort, diligently,
carefully;
 यत्नं कृ take pains, strive after, endeavour at (loc. or
infin.).

यत्नवन्त् a. making effort, energetic, zealous about
(loc.).
यत्प्रभाव a. of what power.

य॑त्र adv. ( = loc. of य॑) where, when, while,
as, if. — यत्र कुत्र (±अपि) wherever, everywhere. यत्र क्व च
(±न) the same, at any time. यत्र क्वापि anywhere, here and there.

(य॑त्रा) adv. ( = loc. of य॑) where, when,
[]
while,
as, if. — यत्र कुत्र (±अपि) wherever, everywhere. यत्र क्व च
(±न) the same, at any time. यत्र क्वापि anywhere, here and there.
यत्रत्य a. where being or dwelling.
यत्रसायंगृह a. resting where evening (comes).
यत्रेच्छक (˚—) where one likes, at pleasure.
यत्रोद्भूत a. where arisen.

यत्संख्याक^1 a. being in what number, counting how
many.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf. ccs, mw, pw.
यातनार्थीय a. subject to torments.
यातय॑ज्जन a. arranging men.
2 यातृ॑ m. avenger.
3 यातृ f. a husband's brother's wife.
या॑तवे dat. inf. to 1 या.
1 यातव्य॑ a. used against witchcraft.

यातव्यपक्ष m. the inimical party (lit. the side to
be gone against).

यातु॑ m. sorcery, witchcraft;
 also = seq.
यातुधा॑न m. ई f. a kind of demons or evil spirits.
यातुम॑न्त् a. practising sorcery.
यातु˚मा॑वन्त् a. practising sorcery.
यातुवि॑द् a. skilled in sorcery.
यातुह॑न् a. destroying witchcraft.
यात्रिन् a. being on a march or in procession.
यात्रोत्सव m. festive procession.
यात्सत्र n. N. of a cert. ceremony.
